title: Hugging Face began as a chatbot app for teenagers
summary: Hugging Face was founded in 2016 in New York by three French founders who first aimed to build a chatbot for teenagers. After Google released BERT in 2019 it shifted toward open source models; in August 2023 it said it was valued at $4.5 billion.

beats.say: Hugging Face began as a chatbot app for teenagers.
Three French founders launched it in New York in twenty sixteen.
They pitched it as a virtual friend for teenagers.
The name comes from an emoji, a smiling face with open hands.
In twenty nineteen, Google researchers released BERT, an open source language model.
Hugging Face engineers built an easier to use version and released it.
A cofounder said it had a huge impact on traction in their community.
The company became a machine learning platform.
In August twenty twenty three, it said it was valued at four point five billion dollars.
A teen chatbot company became a machine learning hub.

claims.note: Wikipedia: in August 2023 Hugging Face said it was valued at $4.5 billion in a $235 million funding round

facts.claim: Hugging Face was founded in 2016 in New York by Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond and Thomas Wolf, as a chatbot app for teenagers
facts.note: Wikipedia: founded 2016 in New York City by three French entrepreneurs; originally a company that developed a chatbot app targeted at teenagers

facts.claim: The founders pitched it as a virtual friend for teenagers
facts.note: Sifted interview: three French founders launched in New York in 2016, aiming at an AI chatbot for teenagers, pitched as 'creating a virtual friend for teenagers'

facts.claim: The name refers to an emoji of a smiling face with open hands
facts.note: Sifted: the name refers to the company's logo, an emoji-style smiling face with open hands; Wikipedia: the name comes from the emoji

facts.claim: In 2019, shortly after Google researchers released BERT, Hugging Face released an easier-to-use version on a new platform and saw a big effect on community traction
facts.note: Sifted: pivot in 2019 shortly after BERT was released; engineers created an easier-to-use version released on a new Hugging Face platform; Chaumond: 'a huge impact on the traction this created in our community'

facts.claim: In August 2023 Hugging Face said it was valued at $4.5 billion in a $235 million funding round
facts.note: Wikipedia: August 2023, $4.5 billion valuation, $235 million round with Salesforce, Google and Nvidia among backers
